tripAdvisorReviews.name: hub by Premier Inn London Westminster, St James's Park hotel
tripAdvisorReviews.address: 15 Dacre Street, Westminster Westminster, London SW1H 0DJ England

reviews.title: Simply Amazing
reviews.text: What an amazing location at an amazing price and what wonderful staff. I could not have been happier. The location is unbeatable - a short walk to major places and the underground. Fantastic room with everything I needed.  Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Great hotell
reviews.text: Great location, close to bus stops.  Easy to find, and not noisy at all. Very clean hotell.  I would come back here another time if we are traveling to London another time. Large bed and clean sheets. The staff of the hotell was very helpfull and very nice. We didn't eat breakfast bc of the selection however that was not a problem.

reviews.title: a nice surprise in Central London
reviews.text:
this hub hotel surprised me: although the room is compact, it has all the amenities for one solo  traveller (maybe for two people that are very close). I went with a friend, but each one stayed in her own room.
the bed is comfortable, the shower is great, the room controls are modern and practical, the breakfast is delicious and cost-effective, and the personnel is nice, attentive and competent. Not to mention the location: there  is a Tube station in the corner! I definitely would stay there again.

reviews.title: Very nice for a London budget hotel
reviews.text: Smart and clean room with a modern atmosphere. Clever storage solutions, although not enough hangers for clothes or hooks for towels. Comfortable bed, very nice panel for adjusting temp and lighting, and you can connect to the tv with a bluetooth device. Breakfast is very basic, not a lot of options, but they do have espresso and tea in the lobby available 24/7. Will probably not choose the breakfast option next time, unless I have no cafe near the hotel.

reviews.title: An unexpected find, with great prices.
reviews.text:
Dropped in here after trying trying to get into several very packed and, very expensive bub/bars near by while killing time before going to a concert at the Central Hall Westminster. I can honesty say well worth it. Beer was £5.50 which in central London is amazing and my wife and daughters got the Jack Rabbit prosecco deal as it was a Friday deal at £18(ish) for the bottle, again in London a steal! 
The seating was clean and comfortable, toilets were clean and had Balis and Harding soap (we notice little things like this). I can really recommend.
